SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN date_dim cd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
          JOIN customer cc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cc.c_customer_sk
          WHERE cd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
            AND cc.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.c_last_name
            AND cc.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.c_first_name
            AND cd.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.d_date
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_sales ws
          JOIN date_dim wd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = wd.d_date_sk
          JOIN customer wc ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = wc.c_customer_sk
          WHERE wd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
            AND wc.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.c_last_name
            AND wc.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.c_first_name
            AND wd.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.d_date
      )
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
